newsitem.title: USA: Trans World Gaming to merge with Tottenham.
newsitem.headline: Trans World Gaming to merge with Tottenham.

text.p: Trans World Gaming Corp said on Monday it has entered a tentative deal to merge with Tottenham & Co, a private gaming consultancy in London.

Under the terms of the proposed merger, Andrew Tottenham, president of Tottenham & Co and a current director at Trans World, will be appointed president and chief executive officer of Trans World, the company said.
Stanley Kohlenberg, the current chairman and chief executive of Trans World Gaming, will remain as Chairman.
Tottenham & Co, which will operate as a wholly owned subsidiary of Trans World, will be acquired for less than $500,000 in cash, notes and common stock, Transworld said.

This transaction, which is expected to close by December 31, 1996, is subject to a number of conditions including the receipt by Trans World Gaming of a fairness opinion of the value of Tottenham & Co, Trans World said.
